## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: One real quarter end to end

      Objective: Discover daily and quarterly sources from listings and ingest every unprocessed one through Stage 1's downloader and parser.

      Produces: listing-based discovery with per-source-file checkpoints; one download/parse path for quarterly and daily sources

      Leaves out: manifests beyond discovery state: Stage 3; scheduling and deployment: Stage 7; full validation suites: Stage 8
      ROUTING: writing-plans

- [ ] Stage 3: Raw snapshots, source manifest and replay
      Objective: Keep original bytes content-addressed and track source, snapshot and processing state so stored inputs can be reprocessed without SEC requests.
      Outcomes: O6
      Consumes: Stages 1–2 downloader, parser and discovery state
      Produces: manifests (§4.5 source manifest records); traceability (raw store and per-parser observation outputs with provenance)
      Exit: O6 — a parser-version change rebuilds observations from stored raw bytes with zero SEC requests; an unchanged hash with unchanged versions is a no-op; an interrupted multi-file run resumes without redoing completed members
      Leaves out: point-in-time awareness: Stage 4; scheduling and deployment: Stage 7; full validation suites: Stage 8
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Versioned quarter publication
      Objective: Publish each affected quarter as a complete generation behind a conditionally updated active pointer.
      Outcomes: O9
      Consumes: Stage 3 observations and manifests
      Produces: point-in-time awareness (quarter generations with manifest, change report and active pointer)
      Exit: O9 — a reader following the pointer sees only complete generations; a crash before the pointer update leaves the previous generation readable; a stale publisher's pointer write is refused
      Leaves out: withdrawal gate: Stage 5; scheduling and deployment: Stage 7; full validation suites: Stage 8
      ROUTING: writing-plans

- [ ] Stage 5: Reconciliation and withdrawal gate
      Objective: Re-read quarterly sources, publish safe changes and gate removals behind hash-bound approval.

      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment: Stages 7 and 9; full validation suites: Stage 8
      ROUTING: writing-plans

      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment: Stage 7; full validation suites: Stage 8
      ROUTING: writing-plans
